policy: Every hole resets to its exact prepared recipe; no carryover or free-base selection. All mass normalized. Labels describe opportunities, not required trajectories. Leg counts are not par or calibrated difficulty. All historical campaigns and reviews preserved. No unlock/control/scoring changes.
